principle_violations.reason: The Order class is handling both order management (items, quantities, prices) and order status management, which are two separate responsibilities.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the order status management into another class or method to adhere to the Single Responsibility Principle.

principle_violations.reason: The PaymentProcessor subclasses contain hardcoded logic for different payment methods. If a new payment method is added, these classes need to be modified.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce a more flexible mechanism, such as using a separate class or strategy pattern for handling payment logic extensions without modifying existing code.

principle_violations.reason: There are repeated strings for update messages across different `PaymentProcessor` implementations.
